beats.text: Every tool needs its own integration.
beats.say: Every tool needs its own custom integration. Three agents and three tools already means nine connections.
The Model Context Protocol, or M C P, is an open standard that lets any agent talk to any tool server in the same way.

beats.text: Servers describe their tools. Agents discover them.
beats.say: A server describes what it offers: tools, resources like files and data, and prompt templates. The agent discovers them at runtime with a list request.

beats.text: Call a tool. Handle the result or the error.
beats.say: To use a tool, the agent sends a call with the tool name and arguments, and gets back a structured result, or an error it can handle.

beats.text: 50 tools? Load only what the task needs.
beats.say: With fifty tools, don't put them all in the prompt. Group or filter them, and load only what the task needs.
And treat tool servers as untrusted: authenticate them, limit their permissions, and validate what comes back.
